subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An entertainer who performs difficult physical feats
solution:
The correct answer is 'Acrobat.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words:-

 
 
• **Archer** - **A person who shoots with a bow and arrows, especially at a target as a sport**.​

 
 
• Example: *The **archer** strung his bow and aimed an arrow at the target*.
 
 
 
• **Acrobat** - **An entertainer who performs spectacular gymnastic feats or performs difficult movements of the body**.
 
 
• Example:* The **acrobat** balanced himself on the high rope*.
 
 
 
• **Artisan** - **A person who makes things skilfully, especially with his/her hands**.
 
 
• Example:* The **artisan** can cut stones into various shapes*.
 
 
 
• **Artist** - **A person who creates paintings or drawings as a profession or hobby**.
 
 
• Example: *The **artist **brought his paints with him*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
